name: Break Compliance
description: Review whether Clockify users took required break time. Checks explicit BREAK time entries against configurable rule templates (German ArbZG, California, Custom).

settings.name: Work threshold (minutes)
settings.description: Once a user has logged this many minutes of work in a day, a qualifying break must appear. Example: 240 = 4 hours.

settings.name: Required break (minutes)
settings.description: Total qualifying break minutes the user must accumulate in a day after crossing the work threshold. Example: 30 (California meal break).

settings.name: Min break segment (minutes)
settings.description: Break entries shorter than this don't count toward the daily required total. Example: ArbZG §4 requires segments ≥15 min to qualify.

settings.name: Max continuous work (minutes)
settings.description: Longest stretch of uninterrupted work allowed before a qualifying break must occur. Findings emit MAX_CONTINUOUS_WORK_EXCEEDED when a user exceeds this without a break.

settings.name: Grace period (minutes)
settings.description: Tolerance added to every threshold so trivial overruns don't fire violations. Example: with work threshold 240 and grace 5, a 244-minute shift is still compliant.

settings.name: Allow split breaks
settings.description: ON: the required break total can be summed from multiple qualifying segments. OFF: a single uninterrupted break of the full required length is needed — turn OFF for California's IWC meal-period rule.

settings.name: Second-tier work threshold (minutes)
settings.description: Set 0 to disable the second tier. Otherwise: when a user crosses this longer shift length, the SECOND-tier required break replaces the first-tier requirement. Example: ArbZG §4 — 540 (9 h) triggers a 45-min total.

settings.name: Second-tier required break (minutes)
settings.description: Set 0 to disable. Otherwise: total qualifying break minutes required once the second-tier work threshold is exceeded. Example: 45 (ArbZG §4 after 9 hours).

settings.name: Time-zone strategy
settings.description: How to compute the day a time entry belongs to when evaluating break requirements. Entry-local keeps each shift on the day the user worked it (recommended for distributed teams).

settings.name: Detect missing break entries
settings.description: ON: detect breaks taken as gaps between work entries. A gap of 5–120 minutes between two consecutive work entries on the same day counts as a qualifying break. Turn ON when your workspace records breaks by stopping the timer rather than logging dedicated BREAK entries.

settings.name: Exempt user ids
settings.description: Optional. User ids listed here are skipped during evaluation — useful for execs, contractors, or anyone whose schedule isn't subject to the workspace's break policy.

settings.name: Refresh debounce (seconds)
settings.description: Optional. How long the addon waits after a Clockify webhook before refreshing findings — bursts of edits coalesce into one re-ingest within this window. Heavy workspaces benefit from longer windows; quiet ones from shorter.

settings.name: Only evaluate approved entries
settings.description: ON: only entries already approved in Clockify count toward break compliance. Work still being edited won't trigger findings. Recommended for workspaces with mandatory approval workflows.

settings.name: Severity — missing break
settings.description: How severe a missing-required-break finding is. Downgrade to WARNING or INFO if you want softer signals during a rollout.

settings.name: Severity — insufficient break
settings.description: Severity used when a user took some break but below the required total.

settings.name: Severity — max continuous work
settings.description: Severity used when a user exceeded the max-continuous-work limit without a qualifying break.

settings.name: Overnight shift bucketing
settings.description: How to attribute time entries whose start and end span a calendar midnight. start-day = whole shift counted on the day it began (default). end-day = whole shift counted on the day it ended.
